record.paper_title: Problems and Conjectures in Matrix and Operator Inequalities
record.original_question: Let p(z) be a polynomial and let W(A) denote the numerical range of a matrix or bounded operator A. What is the smallest universal constant k such that ||p(A)|| ≤ k sup{|p(μ)| : μ∈W(A)} for every matrix or operator A?

evidence.quote:
Problem 10 (Crouzeix) Let p(z) be a polynomial. Find the smallest k such
that for any matrix or operator A
kp(A)k ≤ k sup{|p(µ)| : µ ∈ W(A)}.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a bounded linear operator $A$ on a complex Hilbert space (in particular, for any square complex matrix $A$), let
$$W(A) = \{\langle Ax, x\rangle : \|x\|=1\}$$
denote its numerical range, and let $\|A\|$ denote its operator norm. Determine the smallest universal constant $k>0$ such that, for every bounded operator $A$ on a complex Hilbert space and every polynomial $p \in \mathbb{C}[z]$,
$$\|p(A)\| \le k \sup\{|p(\mu)| : \mu \in W(A)\}.$$
In particular, decide whether $k=2$, i.e. whether $\|p(A)\| \le 2 \sup_{\mu \in W(A)} |p(\mu)|$ holds for all $A$ and all polynomials $p$.
artifact.status_search_result: Crouzeix's conjecture (that the optimal constant is k=2) remains open as of 2025. The best known universal upper bound is 1+√2 (Crouzeix–Palencia, 2017), improving Crouzeix's earlier 11.08. The conjecture has been verified in various special cases (normal matrices, certain 3×3 cases, near-Jordan blocks, some cyclicity-related classes), but no general proof of k=2 exists.

status_evidence.title: Crouzeix's conjecture - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Despite compelling numerical evidence, no proof has yet been found to reduce Crouzeix's constant below 11.08; the Crouzeix–Palencia bound of 1+√2 is the best universal constant known.
status_evidence.claim: The general conjecture k=2 is unresolved; current best universal bound is 1+√2.

status_evidence.title: Remarks on the Crouzeix–Palencia Proof that the Numerical Range is a (1+√2)-Spectral Set
status_evidence.snippet: The numerical range is a (1+√2)-spectral set.

status_evidence.title: Crouzeix's Conjecture and Related Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of cases where the conjecture is known and approaches to the general problem.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture verified in special cases but remains open in general.
